combats.encounter: Burrowing ankheg ambush in the fort

openingActions.summary: Bursts from beneath Wellby, bites for 5 slashing and 3 acid damage, and grapples him in its mandibles.
Fires his readied Eldritch Blast at the ankheg; it misses.

entries.summary: Runs toward the fight from the cistern and casts Sleep at the ankheg. The DM explains how to exclude Wellby from its area; the roll produces no effect.
Rushes beside Wellby. His quarterstaff misses; Flurry of Blows connects and damages the ankheg, which continues holding Wellby.
entries.note: The spoken record does not give damage totals or separate outcomes for both Flurry strikes.

entries.summary: Tries to escape with Acrobatics and fails, remaining grappled.
Advances with sword drawn but cannot reach melee; hits the ankheg with a green blast of energy.
Bites down on Wellby again but cannot secure a damaging grip: no additional damage, and the grapple continues.

Casts Healing Word, restoring 6 hit points to Wellby. Moves within 30 feet and uses Mold Earth beneath the ankheg’s rear legs; the DM sets DC 12 and resolves it falling prone, still holding Wellby beneath its front.

Strikes the mandibles with his quarterstaff to free Wellby instead of dealing damage, then hits with one unarmed strike. The DM later confirms prone granted melee advantage; the successful attacks stand. The proposed Flurry is corrected to one ordinary strike because no ki remains.
Uses Cunning Action to disengage, retreats, and shoots his shortbow. Kenzo’s melee presence permits Sneak Attack; prone imposes disadvantage, so he rerolls. The shot leaves the ankheg badly wounded.
Steps forward and kills the prone ankheg with a longsword strike through its chitin.

ending.summary: The ankheg is dead; Wellby has been freed and healed.

combats.encounter: Skeletons and the staff-bearing undead hobgoblin

openingActions.summary: Delwath makes a Wisdom save on approaching the cavern and freezes momentarily. He identifies a source of the animals’ rage nearby; his later account describes an urge to crush and kill.
Three skeletons drop from the ceiling and approach Delwath at the cave entrance; the party enters initiative.

entries.summary: Moves six squares into view of the skeletons and resolves a Wisdom save with only a momentary shudder. Declines the ki-costing Dash and throws one dart, which misses.
Advances and hits Delwath with a shortsword: attack 24, dealing 8 piercing damage despite Shield.
Casts Shield in reaction to the first skeleton’s attack. It cannot stop that hit but blocks the next skeleton; the table ends it at the start of Delwath’s next turn.
Advances and attacks Delwath; its attack strikes his force shield and misses.
Casts Hex on the first, one-armed skeleton, then strikes it with his sword. Adding 6 Hex damage kills it; Hex can move on a subsequent turn.
Advances after Delwath’s turn, when Shield has expired, and punches him for 1 bludgeoning damage, prompting a DC 10 Constitution concentration save for Hex.
entries.note: The roll result is not spoken; Delwath’s subsequent transfer of Hex confirms it remained available.

entries.summary: Uses Mage Hand to tap the nearest skeleton’s skull; it looks behind itself, then resumes looking at Delwath. Steps back and moves the floating disk in front of himself as a barrier; it tends to drift 10–20 feet away.
Shoots at the upper of the two remaining skeletons and misses; stays in place.
Enters from the rear passage carrying the black iron staff with pulsing obsidian. Demands the party flee and claims the power. Delwath makes another Wisdom save, reporting 16.
entries.note: No explicit outcome is spoken for this particular save.

entries.summary: Smashes one remaining skeleton apart with his quarterstaff and hits the other with an unarmed strike, shattering several bones.
Raises its staff and orders the party to flee. Delwath and Kenzo both resist with Wisdom saves; the attempted effect does nothing.
Transfers Hex to the undead hobgoblin, imposing disadvantage on Dexterity checks, then destroys the last skeleton with his melee attack.
Shoots the hobgoblin with his light crossbow for a glancing hit, then gives Kenzo runic inspiration: one d6 usable after seeing a roll within the next ten minutes.
entries.note: Damage is rolled but its numerical result is not spoken.

entries.summary: Moves forward and makes a Wisdom save; uncontrollable anger comes over him. His shot at the hobgoblin misses on 11. Uses his bonus action to hide against the rock after confirming Kenzo, not he, carries the light.
Charges the hobgoblin and makes a quarterstaff attack followed by two Flurry strikes. Two attacks hit in total; quarterstaff damage is corrected to 4 rather than 6 or 10. Retains his inspiration.
Disappears and reappears farther into the darkness, its staff faintly glowing. Fires two dark-energy bolts at Kenzo; he dodges both.
Moves closer, applies Hexblade’s Curse (+2 damage and critical hits on 19–20), and lands a critical Eldritch Blast.
entries.note: The transcript supplies no resolved damage total.

entries.summary: Fires his crossbow again and misses.

Shoots from hiding. The initial darkness-disadvantage ruling is corrected because the target is in dim light; the table grants advantage from hiding. His arrow deals 13 damage and badly staggers the hobgoblin. Moves and tries to hide again, less successfully.

Uses his inspiration d6 to turn a quarterstaff miss into a hit for 6 damage. His first unarmed strike misses; spends ki for another, which hits and destroys the hobgoblin. The staff falls beside the body, still radiating darkness, anger, and rage.

ending.summary: All three skeletons and the undead hobgoblin are destroyed. The fallen staff’s obsidian continues radiating rage; its later destruction happens after the fight.
